meta.title: dsh-notta
meta.description: Opens a notes panel in the left sidebar under Automation tasks. One vault at a time, defaulting to /Users/ruska/Documents/ob资料库, changeable in the panel. Notes render with mdian and react-markdown using Obsidian formatting: wikilinks, embeds, callouts, highlights, tables, math, Mermaid and Bases views. Entries can be created, renamed, deleted and dragged, and notes are editable in CodeMirror with autosave. Deletes go to .trash.
